Opened by ops-lukas on 2026-09-03

If an export fails (for example the server returns an error), the Export button
stays greyed out and I can't click it again until I reload the whole page.

args.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Change the error handling in the ExportButton component's handleClick function to ensure that the "busy" state is cleared whether the export succeeds or fails. This prevents the export button from remaining disabled after a failed export attempt, allowing the user to try exporting again without reloading the page.
